issues: A grey placeholder Home page; at the end the whole page shrank to 0.37×, leaving card titles and sidebar text around a dozen pixels tall
Light-grey ground against a pure black sky with no horizon or runway, so the low angle never read as skimming at speed
Hovering cards shared the ground's colour and were separated only by a brightness lift; no accent colour or hero
A real product name appeared in the sidebar, and the content was generic placeholder copy
changes: Look switched to lime: the ground is rebuilt as a fictional Tidewell 'Launch week' KPI dashboard with six 84px-number cards, only the Signups hero in solid neon lime
Added a lime grid runway stretching to a glowing horizon; the camera skims forward low over it at the start with the grid flowing, so the ground-skim reads
The rain drop is kept and tightened: 1.6f start offsets, 10f gravity falls, zero bounce, 4–5 cards in the air at once, with spotlight lift, speed blur and shadows that tighten with height
A 60f stand-up with a soft second half ends on a centred frontal dashboard at 87% of frame width; the scene is laid out at 1.5× so the final type is crisp
During the hold the Revenue line draws and the hero number ticks up once, ending on a readable launch-film poster
